options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_host
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center hostname.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_port
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center port.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: cleanConfig
options.description: CleanConfig query parameter. Selecting the clean up configuration option will attempt to remove device settings that were configured during the addition of the device to the inventory and site assignment. Please note that this operation is different from deprovisioning. It does not remove configurations that were pushed during device provisioning.

options.name: cliTransport
options.description: CLI transport. Supported values telnet, ssh. Required if type is NETWORK_DEVICE.

options.name: computeDevice
options.description: Compute Device or not. Options are true / false.

options.name: enablePassword
options.description: CLI enable password of the device. Required if device is configured to use enable password.

options.name: extendedDiscoveryInfo
options.description: This field holds that info as whether to add device with canned data or not. Supported values DISCOVER_WITH_CANNED_DATA.

options.name: httpPassword
options.description: HTTP password of the device / API key for Meraki Dashboard. Required if type is MERAKI_DASHBOARD or COMPUTE_DEVICE.

options.name: httpPort
options.description: HTTP port of the device. Required if type is COMPUTE_DEVICE.

options.name: httpSecure
options.description: Flag to select HTTP / HTTPS protocol. Options are true / false. True for HTTPS and false for HTTP. Default is true.

options.name: httpUserName
options.description: HTTP Username of the device. Required if type is COMPUTE_DEVICE.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. Device ID.

options.name: ipAddress
options.description: IP Address of the device. Required if type is NETWORK_DEVICE, COMPUTE_DEVICE or THIRD_PARTY_DEVICE.

options.name: merakiOrgId
options.description: Selected Meraki organization for which the devices needs to be imported. Required if type is MERAKI_DASHBOARD.

options.name: netconfPort
options.description: Netconf Port of the device. CliTransport must be 'ssh' if netconf is provided. Netconf port is required for eWLC.

options.name: password
options.description: CLI Password of the device. Required if type is NETWORK_DEVICE.

options.name: serialNumber
options.description: Serial Number of the Device. Required if extendedDiscoveryInfo is 'DISCOVER_WITH_CANNED_DATA'.

options.name: snmpAuthPassphrase
options.description: SNMPv3 auth passphrase of the device. Required if snmpMode is authNoPriv or authPriv.

options.name: snmpAuthProtocol
options.description: SNMPv3 auth protocol. Supported values sha, md5. Required if snmpMode is authNoPriv or authPriv.

options.name: snmpMode
options.description: SNMPv3 mode. Supported values noAuthnoPriv, authNoPriv, authPriv. Required if snmpVersion is v3.

options.name: snmpPrivPassphrase
options.description: SNMPv3 priv passphrase. Required if snmpMode is authPriv.

options.name: snmpPrivProtocol
options.description: SNMPv3 priv protocol. Supported values AES128. Required if snmpMode is authPriv.

options.name: snmpROCommunity
options.description: SNMP Read Community of the device. If snmpVersion is v2, at least one of snmpROCommunity and snmpRWCommunity is required.

options.name: snmpRWCommunity
options.description: SNMP Write Community of the device. If snmpVersion is v2, at least one of snmpROCommunity and snmpRWCommunity is required.

options.name: snmpRetry
options.description: SNMP retry count. Max value supported is 3. Default is Global SNMP retry (if exists) or 3.

options.name: snmpTimeout
options.description: SNMP timeout in seconds. Max value supported is 300. Default is Global SNMP timeout (if exists) or 5.

options.name: snmpUserName
options.description: SNMPV3 user name of the device. Required if snmpVersion is v3.

options.name: snmpVersion
options.description: SNMP version. Values supported v2, v3. Required if type is NETWORK_DEVICE, COMPUTE_DEVICE or THIRD_PARTY_DEVICE.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of device being added. Default is NETWORK_DEVICE.

options.name: updateMgmtIPaddressList
options.description: Network Device's updateMgmtIPaddressList.

options.name: userName
options.description: CLI user name of the device. Required if type is NETWORK_DEVICE.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
